XII, 10</cite>) <he>בשעה שהם יוצאים מְ֗מוּסְ֗מָסִים הם מ̇ר̇ו̇ת̇ וכ׳</he> when they (the words of the Law) come out disfigured, they are bitter (drops) to those who hear them; v. <cite ref="M01822"><he>מַס</he> I</cite>; Y. Snh. X, 28ᵃ bot.—

<cite ref="Niddah 24a:17">Nidd. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>מי שפניו מוּסְמָסִים</he> (<he>מוּסְמָסִין</he>) (= <he>מְמוּ׳</he>) a foetus whose face is mashed, contrad. to <he>טוחות</he>, v. <cite ref="I00140"><he>טוּחַ</he> I</cite>.

senses.gloss: (cmp. אָמַץ) to press, urge, esp. (of medical treatment) to sustain vital energies.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82:8">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> <he>כך מְמַסְמְסִין נפשה וכ׳</he> this is the way they stimulate the vital energy of the travailing woman; (Yalk. ib. 136 <he>משיבין</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 263">Yalk. Is. 263</cite> <he>שמסמסין את החיה</he> (corr. acc.).
